cards.design_implication: Design a simulation or statistical inference pipeline that treats the electromagnetic mass lower bound as an explicit conditional input, ensuring radius results are tagged according to whether this constraint is activated.
does_not_establish: The specific statistical method used to apply the constraint.
The calibration or selection criteria for the electromagnetic observation.
Causal links between mass constraints and tidal deformability.
Generalizability of this conditional constraint to other gravitational-wave events or detector networks.
cards.evidence_excerpt: If we additionally require that the equation of state supports neutron stars with masses larger than 1.97 M_{⊙} as required from electromagnetic observations and employ the equation-of-state parametrization, we further constrain R_{1}=11.9_{-1.4}^{+1.4} km and R_{2}=11.9_{-1.4}^{+1.4} km at the 90% credible level.
limitations: Only states that the radius values differ when the 1.97 solar mass constraint is applied.
Does not define the method or instrument settings used to derive the 1.97 solar mass limit from electromagnetic observations.
Abstract-level evidence only; full implementation details are not provided.
cards.statement: The reported neutron star radius constraints depend on whether the analysis additionally requires that the equation of state supports neutron stars with masses larger than 1.97 solar masses as indicated by electromagnetic observations.
